Name: Seasonal Portraits and Sprites for Anthony
Author: Whystardewvalley
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
This mod provides a full seasonal portrait and sprite overhaul for Anthony, Harvey's brother. Using the Appearances System, Anthony now changes clothes naturally across every season, dons a work uniform while on shift at Pierre’s General Store, and wears appropriate swimwear when visiting the Ginger Island resort.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[*]Ensure you have [b]SMAPI[/b], [b]Content Patcher[/b], and the base [b]Anthony mod by BlackBerryLTDA[/b] installed.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip the folder.[/*]
[*]Place the
[code]Anthony - Seasonal Outfits and Reskin[/code]folder directly into your
[code]Stardew Valley/Mods[/code]directory.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size][/*]
[*][b]4-Season Wardrobe:[/b] Dedicated seasonal portrait and sprite combinations for Spring, Summer, Fall, and Winter.[/*]
[*][b]Workplace Uniform:[/b] Changes into a green button-up uniform whenever he is inside Pierre's.[/*]
[*][b]Ginger Island Beach Attire:[/b] Automatically switches into custom resort wear when visiting the island.[/*]
[*][b]Vanilla Matching Style:[/b] Custom pixel art tailored specifically to blend into the vanilla game's aesthetic.
